name: debug
description: Systematically debug an issue by reproducing the error, isolating the cause, and verifying the fix. Supports log analysis, stack trace reading, and test-based debugging.

inputs.name: errorOutput
inputs.description: The error message or stack trace to debug.

outputs.name: analysis
outputs.description: Root cause analysis: errorType, rootCause, affectedFile, affectedLine, suggestedFix, confidenceLevel.

failureConditions.signal: reproduction steps fail to trigger the error
no clear source file or line in the stack trace
